notes:
Prospect: mid/large EU financial software org building internal developer platform. Wants enterprise-grade IDE copilot across 800+ devs. Primary ask: secure private deployment (VPC or on-prem) so no customer code leaves their control.

Conversation highlights: 
- "We need streaming suggestions in the editor that feel instant — 50-150ms p99 for single-line completions." said lead eng.
- Strong requirement to pin model versions for reproducible suggestions and to allow A/B of model variants for risk calibration.
- CISO: must have SSO (SAML + SCIM), full immutable audit logs, retention policy configurable per project, and HSM-backed keys for secrets.
- Wants fallback policy: dedicated/VPC for sensitive repos; hosted or quantized variants for public/internal utility repos to reduce cost.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to hit cost targets while meeting latency SLOs.

POC ask: 4-week pilot, 50-75 engineers, VSCode extension integration, measure: p50/p95 latency for streaming completions, suggestion accuracy (dev acceptance rate), and audit log completeness.

Quote from security reviewer: "Need architecture diagram showing key separation, KMS flows, and where audit logs are stored — legal will not sign w/out SLA on retention and e-discovery support."

Immediate next: deliver KMS/HSM design doc and VPC onboarding checklist; Alicia to run infra demo and send dedicated pricing options.
